messages:
anya: Quick thread to lock pilot gating decisions for the Optimize Toolkit. Need final calls on residency, econ gates, and safety rollbacks.

sanjay: I'll flag infra constraints up-front: VPC runners add delivery time and SRE support. We should minimize VPC-only features for M0.

claire: Agreed. Proposal: Phase A (pilot): advisory-only quant recs, templated eval alerts, strict redaction. Phase B: auto-apply + residency features after pilot success.

ben: For pilot acceptance we need a measurable econ/latency threshold. My suggested rule: require an "impact score" >= 0.6 where impact score = weighted(norm_cost_savings, norm_latency_drop, norm_quality_delta). We can pick weights later but the idea is to prevent enabling auto-apply without clear upside.

marta: Customers we plan to sign: AcmeHealth (needs VPC option) and Inboxly (hosted ok). Legal will want explicit opt-in for sending any full-context examples out of a VPC.

anya: Decision: default to redacted examples in alerts. Full context lives in customer-owned storage and is linked (not included). Any unredacted sample requires explicit signed consent + legal signoff.

claire: Rollback safety: auto-apply (phase B) must include a safety filter: if measured quality drop > 3% absolute on the labeled harness or any user-visible regression flagged by customer within 24h, auto-rollback and alert ops.

ben: For Phase A acceptance, propose these ACs:
```
AC-1: Alerts redact PII by default; examples truncated to <= 100 chars and linked to customer VPC or storage.
AC-2: Quant advisor shows top-2 configs with side-by-side sample diffs + estimated delta (latency ms, cost %).
AC-3: Pilot opt-in per-model per-customer; hosted profiling allowed for non-sensitive customers; VPC profiling available for customers who request it and sign residency SLA.
AC-4: Impact score calculation implemented; advisory recs surfaced when impact_score >= 0.4.
AC-5: Alert delivery SLA: console + webhook within 25 minutes 95% of the time.
```

sanjay: Implementation note: to contain cost, profile runs default to 500 samples/model/run for pilot and are rate-limited. We can expose cadence settings (daily/weekly) but cap weekly to 1000 samples for pilot customers.

marta: Also require a "residency badge" in the UI: shows whether a sample was redacted, pulled from VPC, or hosted. UI must make residency obvious.

anya: UX ask: make the diff view compact — small sample column and an "impact strip" (cost bar, latency icon, quality delta percent). No full-run diffs in pilot UI.

ben: Econ gate for enabling auto-apply in Phase B: need either (a) unit cost reduction >= 12% AND impact_score >= 0.6 on at least 2 pilot customers; OR (b) p95 latency decrease >= 80ms AND impact_score >= 0.6 on at least 2 pilot customers. Otherwise keep advisory-only.

claire: On-call/runbook: include steps to mark an alert as "ignored/known" per customer, and a manual override to pause auto-apply in case of repeated false positives. Also include a point-of-contact for legal/privacy.

marta: Legal requirement: any customer-supplied prompt suites must be accompanied by a signed data-use agreement if we host them for profiling. No profiling until legal signs off for that customer.

anya: Quick UX/ops ACs to add:
```
AC-UI-1: Residency badge present on each alert and on advisor cards.
AC-OPS-1: Profiling run shows estimated cost before start and requires explicit confirmation for hosted runs.
AC-SAFE-1: Auto-apply safety net: immediate rollback if quality_delta <= -3% on labeled harness or if customer reports regression within 24h.
```

ben: We should also limit automatic changes to one model-config change per week per customer during Phase B to reduce churn risk.

claire: Test plan for alert precision: combine customer-labeled failing suites + synthetic mutations to measure precision/recall. Target precision >= 0.8 on combined set for pilot acceptance.

sanjay: Action items: 
- @sanjay: prototype VPC runner flow + cost estimator and demo run by Tue.
- @claire: mockups for residency badge + compact diff UI by Wed.
- @ben: draft impact_score formula and initial weights; run econ sim against AcmeHealth/Inboxly data by Thu.
- @marta: draft legal checklist and data-use agreement template; coordinate privacy signoff.

ops-bot: reminder set for 1767080000: "Optimize Toolkit pilot artifacts due" :bell:

anya: Great — I'll capture these as the gating page in the initiative doc and route to legal/SRE for sign-off. If no objections by EOW we lock for pilot outreach.
